pool.message: i dont even know how to keep going. the debt is just... it's a mountain. every time i think i've made progress i just sink deeper. i feel like i'm drowning and there's no way out. it's just a cycle that never ends and i'm so tired of fighting it.
i feel like i've just hit a wall. everything that's happened... it's just too much. i dont think there's anything left of me to fix. i'm just fundamentally broken at this point.

i feel like im just walking through this thick fog for so long now. the path used to be clear, but lately everything is just grey and heavy. i've reached this edge where the trail just... stops. there's nothing left to walk on, just a long drop into nothingness. it feels like the journey was never meant to go any further.
